subject: Discovery follow-up: Schedule demo / loop in security & procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@finpath.com>, Amit Desai <amit@finpath.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: Schedule demo / loop in security & procurement

Hi Sarah (and Amit),

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference for FinPath's customer support and document summarization pipelines.
- Main technical priorities you mentioned: data isolation, SOC 2 evidence, and predictable latency at 1-2s p95.
- Procurement/contract rhythm: you said procurement typically needs a short checklist + a SOC2 artifact.

Next step: schedule a 60-min demo / technical deep dive where we'll have an SE join to walk architecture, latency testing, deployment options (hosted vs dedicated), and answer procurement/security questions. Proposed slots (all PT):
- Thu, Sep 17 — 10:00-11:00
- Thu, Sep 17 — 14:00-15:00
- Fri, Sep 18 — 11:00-12:00

Can you pick a slot that works? Also, it would be helpful if you could loop in your procurement and security stakeholders so we can address their questions live. On our side I plan to bring Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer) and Neha Kapoor (Security & Compliance). If useful, we can also include Vivek Kulkarni from our procurement team for contract-level questions.

I'll hold the two best slots tentatively until I hear back.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

--
Redwood Inference | developer-first LLM inference

From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Desai <amit@finpath.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: Schedule demo / loop in security & procurement

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap.

All good on the summary. Thu, Sep 17 14:00-15:00 PT works best for our team. I'll also loop in Alison Price (procurement) and Amit (CTO) will join the call. Will Alison be able to get the procurement checklist ahead of time? I'm attaching a short procurement questionnaire we typically send to vendors (procurement-questions.xlsx).

Also, can you provide a SOC 2 summary or evidence we can share with our InfoSec team ahead of the meeting?

Looking forward to the demo.

Thanks,
Sarah Johnson
Head of Product, FinPath
sarah.johnson@finpath.com

Attachment: procurement-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@finpath.com>, Amit Desai <amit@finpath.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: Schedule demo / loop in security & procurement

Thanks, Sarah — confirmed for Thu, Sep 17 14:00-15:00 PT.

Agenda (proposed) — 60 min:
1) 10 min — quick recap & success criteria (Marissa + Sarah)
2) 30 min — technical deep dive (Dev Patel): architecture, latency profile, KV cache, and deployment options
3) 10 min — security/compliance overview (Neha Kapoor): SOC 2 scope, data handling, KMS/HSM options
4) 10 min — procurement/next steps (Marissa + Vivek)

Neha & Dev — looping you in to review the questions Sarah attached (procurement-questions.xlsx) and prepare any artifacts (SOC2-summary.pdf attached) we can share in advance. Vivek — if you can be available to speak to commercial/terms in the last 10 minutes, that would be great.

I'll send a calendar invite and include the HubSpot meeting link: https://redwood.app/hubspot/engagements/FP-2026-0098.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Marissa. The calendar invite came through and the agenda looks good. Alison will join for procurement and will do a short pre-call with our legal team on Monday to review the checklist.

No additional items from our side today. See you Thu at 14:00 PT.

Best,
Sarah
